'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Steve Baroni LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Where are you, Elyk Rhue?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
